name: marekkirejczyk-skills
description: Marek Kirejczyk's agent skills. explain-with-slides: a slide deck walking through any repository or pull request, with screenshots from the running code. explain-with-video: the same walkthrough as a narrated video with captions. refactor-tests: brings a file, class or branch's tests up to written rules for each test type, and covers every case. self-documented-code: renames everything in a scope so each name explains itself and each concept has one name. dont-repeat-yourself: finds concepts implemented more than once and gives each one well-tested implementation. eval-report: runs a repository's evals and turns the results into one static HTML report for fast review, linked from the pull request. refactor-evals: brings an eval suite's cases up to written rules, with one requirement per case, duplicates merged and every red case diagnosed. make-code-readable-again: runs refactor-tests, dont-repeat-yourself and self-documented-code on one scope, in rounds, until a round changes nothing.
